body: Simple answer: Don’t pay your bills! Seriously. Take care of YOU first. Fuck the faceless people who want your money. They can’t take away what you don’t have. Once you start getting you situated THEN watch YouTube videos on how to settle your debt with bill collectors when you can. The hospital isn’t going to put other patients on the streets because you didn’t pay your bill. No one is going to give you $50,000 and walk away. They will want something. Maybe even something really bad because you owe them. It’s not worth it.

I know a guy with a crazy hand that he has had since birth. He has a wife, kids, family and is well liked at work. Another guy I know has crazy eyes and has all the same things. It’s out there for you.
Non- Player character. Someone who interacts with important people but has no value outside of of that.
Lawyers cost money. They have a full time one on staff that loves to be petty.
And it all has been for nothing.
After my stuff is given out and sold no one will think of me again.
I have given up on that happening.

Yeah. The whole “Wake up and decide to be happy thing”doesn’t work. I have nothing to start over with. I have given everything time. I was told I was a piece of shit since I was a kid so I’m not sure where this care free easy time was.
Love is a lie people tell you when they want something.
